title: Vector and Echo
author: Silas Villalobos
blurb: Zephyrine Dunmore, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
